name: intragile/laravel-ksef
description: Polish KSeF e-invoicing for Laravel: send FA(3) invoices to KSeF 2.0 online, offline and in batches, receive them on a schedule, enrol KSeF certificates and print KOD I/KOD II QR codes, on top of intragile/laravel-einvoicing.

suggest.chillerlan/php-qrcode: Renders the KSeF verification links (KOD I and KOD II) as SVG or PNG QR codes (^5; PNG needs ext-gd)
suggest.ext-zip: Needed for KSeF batch sessions and invoice export packages (ZIP archives)
